supersedes.override: The nonflat fresh-FD P10 gate is diagnostic during this continuously refreshed OAC pilot, not an admission gate before the first Actor update.
supersedes.reason: The frozen-Query environment supplies every Actor-visited candidate with a real scalar cost, Twin Critics receive 20 updates before each single capped Actor update, and round zero remains eligible for real-Query checkpoint selection.

split_contract.fit_usage: Actor-visited collection plus Critic and Actor updates
split_contract.inner_selection_usage: real frozen-Query checkpoint selection only; round zero participates
split_contract.oof_usage: one evaluation of the frozen selected checkpoint per seed plus post-selection FD diagnosis; never selects a checkpoint, threshold, seed, or hyperparameter

pilot.context_stratification: one fit context per speed_kph x road variant cell each round, cycling deterministic shuffled queues
pilot.candidate_contract: current Actor center plus 16 antithetic full-rank probes plus six forward-response proposals

critic_updates.target_transform: retain each pretrained Twin Critic's fit-only standardized log1p Query J50 transform

actor_updates.objective: mean conservative max(Q1,Q2) physical log1p Query cost plus output trust to the currently selected Actor checkpoint
actor_updates.step_cap_semantics: cap only over all fit-context deterministic outputs; never enlarge a naturally smaller update

checkpoint_selection.metric: inner-selection real frozen-Query direct mean J50

outcome_gates.fresh_fd_role: diagnostic and stop/routing evidence after checkpoint selection; negative P10 alone does not retrospectively invalidate a real-Query-improving selected Actor

fresh_fd_diagnostic.population: outer-fold OOF states at the selected Actor checkpoint
fresh_fd_diagnostic.flat_definition: bottom 25 percent of true finite-difference gradient norm within each seed
report: flat and nonflat true/predicted gradient norm
nonflat cosine median/P10 and median norm ratio
